maintenance_led.reason: Sells cannabis consumables through its own dispensaries; products are used up, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Dispensary sales of cannabis to medical patients and recreational consumers, paid privately; not covered by Medicare or Medicaid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by cultivating, manufacturing and opening its own dispensaries, with occasional acquisitions such as Harvest and Cannabist.

mission_critical.reason: Retail cannabis flower and products bought by consumers and patients, who can easily switch to other dispensaries.
